newsitem.title: USA: Conseco execs exercise 8.6 mln share options.
newsitem.headline: Conseco execs exercise 8.6 mln share options.

text.p: Conseco Inc said Friday its chief executive and executive vice presidents have exercised outstanding stock options to purchase about 8.6 million shares of the company's common stock.
As a result, the company will realize a tax deduction of about $225 million, equal to the tax gain recognized by the executives.

Participants paid for the exercised options by tendering about 2.9 million previously owned shares, and Conseco said it withheld about 2.6 million exercised shares to cover related taxes owed by the executives. No cash was exchanged, and the executives received a total of 3.1 million shares.

Conseco said its compensation committee also granted new options at the current market price equal to the number of shares withheld for the exercise price and taxes. The new options are part of an incentive plan for executives to exercise options, the company said.

Conseco said the number of shares owned by executives increased and dilution from stock options decreased as a result of the program. The program also kept executives from selling a large number of shares in the open market to pay the owed taxes, the company said.
